task_title: Wire Floor 2 equipment economy flag into real shipped path

plan_review.notes: Adversarial-style rubber-duck review flagged: (1) headless-runner.ts unconditionally calls runSettlementMaintenancePlanner every tick, a real AI consumer of Quartermaster stock missed in the initial investigation (corrected via grep + code read); (2) needed evidence the AI purchasing path does not break Floor 2 balance/AI or interact badly with carryover; (3) wanted an interactive UI observation for boss chests. Resolved: (1) confirmed via source read that the planner is intentional, bounded (8-iteration cap), fail-safe (blacklist-and-continue), latch-gated, and a Floor 1 no-op; (2) added a new default-path headless test asserting the planner runs end-to-end against real economy-enabled stock without error across a full run, confirmed validateGeneratedCarryover does not require unclaimed registry instances to be claimed (no orphan-bloat risk), and confirmed no floor3 scenario exists yet so the carryover-boundary risk raised is currently moot (documented as a caveat in the handoff); (3) judged headless evidence plus already-merged BossChestUI wiring sufficient for this flag-only change since the interactive UI itself is untouched by this PR.
